Mission Local reported that San Francisco State lecturers were told their spring classes would be cut, with some losing one or two classes and others losing their entire workloads. The story said lecturers faced the largest reductions: about a 30 percent decrease for most colleges. The university’s budget committee presentation said cuts could equal 125 full-time positions; the number of lecturers affected was unknown.
